angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 473,076 km at 91.13 pc = 0.07 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 10.9739 +/- 0.0282 mas (same row, RUWE 1.92): 91.13 pc, no zero-point correction; the RUWE is high, so the astrometry fits a single star poorly, and the parallax is used as published
radiusSource: Radius 0.68 +/- 0.07 solar radii from Hellier et al. 2019, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of WASP-145 A b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019MNRAS.482.1379H/abstract): 473,076 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.76 +/- 0.04 solar masses from Hellier et al. 2019, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of WASP-145 A b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019MNRAS.482.1379H/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 4900 +/- 150 K from Hellier et al. 2019, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of WASP-145 A b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019MNRAS.482.1379H/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Hellier et al. 2019, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of WASP-145 A b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019MNRAS.482.1379H/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/wasp-145-a.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.654, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-145 A (pscomppars): spectral type K2 V, from Hellier et al. 2019 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019MNRAS.482.1379H/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-145 A (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.04 dex, from Hellier et al. 2019 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019MNRAS.482.1379H/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-145 A (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.68352, from Gaia DR2 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018A&A...616A...1G/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-145 A (pscomppars): age 6.99 Gyr, from Hellier et al. 2019 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019MNRAS.482.1379H/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-145 A (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 2.1 km/s, from Hellier et al. 2019 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019MNRAS.482.1379H/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
